metas.name: Lenin Pandiyan
metas.description: Set alongside on the riverbanks of Maanamadurai in the Sivagangai district, the premise is about a very gullible, innocent old couple in their late 60s, 70s who inadvertently get intertwined in the political lobby of sand mining which is currently a major issue in the local district. By the orders from a steadfast judge, to ensure protection & safeguard them from the vindictive political system, they nominate a weakest unassuming rookie police constable .The emotional bond between the rookie policeman and the couple & how they avenge the entrenched political system with fortuitous incidents as a new found allies forms the rest of the narrative.

metas.name: Pulp Fiction
metas.description: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

metas.name: #Home
metas.description: Oliver Twist (Indrans) wants to be tech-savvy and become a better companion to his two sons, who spend more time on their phones than with their loved ones.

metas.name: Video
metas.description: Video is a found footage, Docudrama by Srinidhi Bengaluru that stars Dheekshith Shetty, Bharatha, Jeevan Shivakumar, Tejesh S M, Priya J Achar, Nalme Nachiyar.

metas.name: Gol Maal
metas.description: A man's simple lie to secure his job escalates into more complex lies when his orthodox boss gets suspicious.

metas.name: Hushar Pittalu
metas.description: In a village, two teenagers fall into a secret relationship, driven by curiosity and bad influences. As their families oppose them, the couple rebels, exposing how youthful attraction and parental mistakes can change lives forever.

metas.name: Avengers: Endgame
metas.description: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.

metas.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Infinity Castle
metas.description: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank Hindi mein demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

metas.name: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
metas.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.

metas.name: Dhurandhar
metas.description: A mysterious traveler slips into the heart of Karachi's underbelly and rises through its ranks with lethal precision, only to tear the notorious ISI-Underworld nexus apart from within.

metas.name: The Wolf of Wall Street
metas.description: Based on the true story of Jordan Belfort, from his rise to a wealthy stock-broker living the high life to his fall involving crime, corruption and the federal government.

metas.name: K.G.F: Chapter 2
metas.description: In the blood-soaked Kolar Gold Fields, Rocky's name strikes fear into his foes, while the government sees him as a threat to law and order. Rocky must battle threats from all sides for unchallenged supremacy.

metas.name: The Truman Show
metas.description: An insurance salesman begins to suspect that his whole life is actually some sort of reality TV show.

metas.name: Enna Vilai
metas.description: A humble fisherman from Rameswaram lives a quiet life with his family until he finds a gold pendant washed ashore. What initially seems like a blessing soon turns into a nightmare when false accusations threaten his peace and dignity, forcing him to stand up against a powerful system.

metas.name: Wild Tales
metas.description: Six short stories that explore the extremities of human behavior involving people in distress.

metas.name: Barfi!
metas.description: Three young people learn that love can neither be defined nor contained by society's definition of normal and abnormal.

metas.name: Mahendragiri Vaaraahi
metas.description: Siddharth, an atheist and skeptic, is drawn into a mysterious journey surrounding the ancient Varahi temple at Mahendragiri. As he uncovers secrets connected to the sacred site, he is forced to confront forces beyond his understanding, challenging his beliefs and changing his perception of faith, destiny, and the supernatural.

metas.name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
metas.description: Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange after his identity destroys the life he knows, but a magical mistake draws powerful outsiders into his world and forces him to confront what being Spider Man really means.

metas.name: Chak De! India
metas.description: Kabir Khan, the coach of the Indian Women's National Hockey Team, dreams of making his all-girls team emerge victorious against all odds.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: My Name Is Khan
metas.description: Rizwan Khan is a Muslim immigrant to the US with Asperger's syndrome. After his family falls apart in the aftermath of 9/11, he begins an epic quest across the country to speak to the President of the United States and clear his n...

metas.name: Friends
metas.description: Three friends, who value friendship over everything else, begin to fall apart when one of them learns about a shocking incident that happened in their past.

metas.name: Aayitha Ezhuthu
metas.description: Three men and their accidental meeting on Napier Bridge will change their lives forever.

metas.name: Natsamrat
metas.description: The film is the story of an actor who has reached many heights in his career but has to retire from acting at the peak.

metas.name: The Batman
metas.description: When a sadistic serial killer begins murdering key political figures in Gotham, the Batman is forced to investigate the city's hidden corruption and question his family's involvement.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

metas.name: RRR
metas.description: A fearless warrior on a perilous mission comes face to face with a steely cop serving British forces in this epic saga set in pre-independent India.

metas.name: Laila Majnu
metas.description: Taking the leap out of the classic folklore, the story is set in today's time in Kashmir where Laila Majnu have problems relevant to the youth of today. While dealing with their feuding families a passionate love story unravels.

metas.name: Karwaan
metas.description: Two friends and a chirpy teenager take a road trip from Bangalore to Kochi.

metas.name: Hichki
metas.description: Suffering from Tourette Syndrome, Naina gets assigned a class of defiant students and must ensure that her students realise their potential.

metas.name: Rahasya
metas.description: A Doctor stands accused of killing his own eighteen-year old daughter. While this aggrieved father protests his innocence, all evidence points towards him irrefutably.

metas.name: Thupparivaalan
metas.description: A detective is hungry for a challenging case to investigate and the mystery of a murdered dog leads to a rival who could be the match for him.

metas.name: Tenzing
metas.description: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

metas.name: Promising Young Woman
metas.description: An unexpected encounter gives a wickedly smart and cunning woman a chance to right the wrongs from her past.

metas.name: Les Misérables
metas.description: In 19th-century France, Jean Valjean, who, for decades, has been hunted by the ruthless policeman Javert after breaking parole, agrees to care for a factory worker's daughter. The decision changes their lives forever.

metas.name: Rental Family
metas.description: An American actor in Tokyo struggling to find purpose lands an unusual gig: working for a Japanese "rental family" agency, playing stand-in roles for strangers. He rediscovers purpose, belonging, and the beauty of human connection.

metas.name: Sardar
metas.description: A spy, who is estranged from his family due to a mission, suddenly meets his police officer son.

metas.name: Khuda Haafiz: Chapter 2 - Agni Pariksha
metas.description: Sameer and Nargis, after overcoming all odds, find a ray of sunshine when little Nandini enters their lives and their family is complete; But their happiness is short-lived. In a bizarre twist of fate, Nandini goes missing.

metas.name: Dracula
metas.description: Centuries-old vampire Count Dracula comes to England to seduce his barrister Jonathan Harker's fiancée Mina Murray and wreak havoc in the foreign land.

metas.name: Billa
metas.description: A cop chases international gangster Billa and happens to be the only one to see him die. He places Velu, Billa's lookalike, inside the gang to get information. But Velu is framed for killing the cop.

metas.name: Chhaava
metas.description: After the death of his father, warrior-king Sambhaji Maharaj battles Mughal forces led by Aurangzeb to keep the Maratha Empire alive.

metas.name: The Hundred-Foot Journey
metas.description: The Kadam family leaves India for France where they open a restaurant directly across the road from Madame Mallory's Michelin-starred eatery.

metas.name: Vishwanath and Sons
metas.description: Sanjay Vishwanath has devoted decades to excellence as an international shooter. When age, family duties, and an unexpected romance collide with his ambitions, he must confront what truly makes a life worth living.

metas.name: The Inventor: Out for Blood in Silicon Valley
metas.description: The story of Theranos, a multi-billion dollar tech company, its founder Elizabeth Holmes, the youngest self-made female billionaire, and the massive fraud that collapsed the company.

metas.name: Strange Days
metas.description: During the last days of 1999 in a gritty, futuristic Los Angeles, an ex-cop turned street hustler finds himself thrown into a conspiracy of murder and blackmail.

metas.name: Naanum Rowdy Thaan
metas.description: A wannabe rowdy who falls for a hearing-impaired girl faces a dilemma when the girl makes a shocking request.

metas.name: The Invisible Man
metas.description: When Cecilia's abusive ex takes his own life and leaves her his fortune, she suspects his death was a hoax. As a series of coincidences turn lethal, Cecilia works to prove that she is being hunted by someone nobody can see.

metas.name: The White Tiger
metas.description: An ambitious Indian driver uses his wit and cunning to escape from poverty and rise to the top. An epic journey based on the New York Times bestseller.

metas.name: Raajneeti
metas.description: Samar, the son of a political family, has chosen to go to the USA to live with his girlfriend. However, the death of his father makes him put his plans on hold and enter the dirty world of politics.

metas.name: I Am Kathalan
metas.description: A college student decides to hack into the security system of a company owned by his ex-girlfriend's father.
